---
title: "Privacy"
description: "What this site records about visits, and what happens to the emails you send us."
# Subtitle on the social preview card (_social-cards/README.md).
social-card:
  sub: "What we record, and what we don’t"
---

We count visits to this site, to see which pages people read. The counter
uses no cookies and collects no personal information.

If you close the announcement at the top of the page, your browser remembers
that, on your device only, so it stays closed. Nothing about it is sent to us.

If you email us, we use your address only to reply. If you join the email
list, we send a few emails a year, and you can reply "unsubscribe" any time.

If you share an error story, we won't quote, publish or use it in our
research without asking you first.

Questions? Write to
<span class="email-obfuscate" data-user="contact" data-domain="productive-error.org">contact [at] productive-error.org</span>.
